Debt is a form of credit or loan of funds, both cash and securities to meet needs. It can also be said if debt is money that you borrow from other people. Loans or debts must be returned within the agreed period. The amount of debt or debt depends on the needs of each individual or company.
Receivables are the provision of credit or loan funds both in cash and non-cash to individuals and companies. In general, receivables occur because someone cannot pay off the transaction on time. In another sense, receivables is a term for money that you lend to other people.
